summary: Iteration 22 (CSV import + shortage alerts + run sheet + video timestamp scrubber) — Backend + Frontend all pass. 10/10 pytest tests green covering: costume/equipment CSV import (dry_run vs real, missing-name = invalid, duplicate by name, auto-create categories + locations); shortage flag computed correctly on GET /api/costumes list, GET /api/costumes/{id}, and PUT /api/costumes/{id} across three states (not-in-use → false, in_use+qty<assigned → true, in_use+no assignments → false). Frontend Playwright confirmed: Inventory import wizard opens with 'Step 1 of 4' and closes via X; Equipment page opens the same wizard; shortage badges render on inventory cards (2 costumes, 'SHORT · 3'); Wardrobe shortage banner + chips + red-bordered tiles + wardrobe-cost-shortage badges + Print Run Sheet button (enabled, 3 students assigned); 3 run-sheet-page-{student_id} nodes present inside .wardrobe-print-only; VTS toggle button reveals YouTube player + Capture + Jump buttons in the Costume edit dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4282 lines — hitting the >700-line rule hard; iteration_11 already flagged this. Import-wizard endpoints (~2686-2960) are natural candidates to move into a routers/imports.py module.

Import: category/location auto-create sets create_missing_* default True. Consider surfacing the auto-created counts in the response payload (e.g. auto_created_categories/locations) so the wizard's 'preview' step can warn the user. Currently the caller has no signal about how many new taxonomy rows were minted.

Shortage flag is computed on every read via _apply_shortage() — fine for now but if the list grows into the thousands it would be cheaper to persist it on writes (single field update) and re-derive only when in_use/quantity/assignments change.

Import endpoint counts a row as 'created' even when dry_run=true (returned under would_create). The internal counter reuse works but is easy to misread; a separate would_create counter would improve maintainability.

Costume/Equipment import endpoints trust the client-provided sizes dict shape (Dict[str, str]) — malformed values are silently skipped. Consider returning per-row warnings in preview for debuggability.

success_rate.frontend: 5/5 flows pass — inventory wizard, equipment wizard, inventory shortage badges, wardrobe banner+tiles+print-btn+run-sheet DOM, VTS toggle→player/capture/jump

seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_CIMP_/TEST_EIMP_/TEST_SHORT_/TEST_ITER22_CAT_/TEST_ITER22_LOC_ rows. No teardown — small volume, name-prefixed for future cleanup.
